tasks.short: Supervise earth, marine, atmospheric or space-science laboratory and field work.

inputs: actual student research plans
actual field/laboratory requirements and permissions

actual student activity and observed field/laboratory conditions
outputs: actual supervision observations and chosen feedback

inputs: actual supervision observations and chosen feedback
outputs: checked final actual laboratory/field supervision record

steps.what: Save checked actual laboratory/field supervision record
inputs: checked final actual laboratory/field supervision record

tasks.enabler_now: Native plan links and record fields can reduce repetition.

tasks.short: Plan, evaluate and revise physical-science curricula and instruction.

steps.what: Retrieve and check actual curriculum, course content, learner evidence and institutional requirements
inputs: actual current curriculum and course materials
actual learner evidence and institutional requirements

steps.what: Plan and evaluate curricula, course content, materials and methods and choose actual revisions
inputs: checked actual curriculum evaluation sources
actual scientific and pedagogical objectives
outputs: actual chosen curriculum/content/method revisions and rationale

steps.what: Draft actual curriculum and instructional revisions from teacher-chosen changes and source versions
inputs: actual chosen curriculum/content/method revisions and rationale
checked actual curriculum evaluation sources

loop.input: exact existing curriculum and teacher-chosen changes
loop.check: Check meaning, scientific accuracy, prerequisite sequence, learning outcomes and omissions against chosen revisions
loop.stop: Missing source or two failed checks means manual revision
loop.why_not_simpler: Native version comparison/templates first; variable revision prose alone needs bounded drafting

steps.what: Check complete final curriculum revisions, scientific/pedagogical consequences and actual adoption authority
inputs: source-linked actual revised curriculum/content draft
actual chosen curriculum/content/method revisions and rationale
outputs: checked final curriculum revision and authorised record/release destinations

steps.what: Save checked final curriculum and instructional revisions
inputs: checked final curriculum revision and authorised record/release destinations

steps.what: Release exact checked curriculum revisions through actual authorised institutional course route
inputs: checked final curriculum revision and authorised record/release destinations
outputs: actual permitted revision released or submitted for institutional adoption

tasks.design: Configure native course/source links in {LMS} and {DOCS}, then draft prose only for teacher-chosen revisions. Retain actual evaluation and curriculum choices, checking the complete final version before separate save and authorised institutional release.
tasks.previous_blocker: Curriculum work can repeat source navigation and revision prose.
tasks.enabler_now: Native version links and bounded drafting can reduce those repetitions.
tasks.still_hard: Scientific sequencing and effective instruction require academic judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher recognises when revised content would leave a prerequisite gap.
tasks.altitude: Less revision administration; academic judgement stays human.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native course/version links and bounded revision drafting can support curriculum administration; they do not choose learning objectives or determine pedagogical effectiveness.

assumptions: Actual course/institution owners supply source versions and requirements; actual assessments/feedback produce learner evidence. Teacher verifies sources and chooses every scientific/pedagogical revision in retained s2.

S3 retains 17.5 provisional hours of chosen-change capture and draft checking; s4 retains full final meaning/omission review. Teacher may release only within actual authority; otherwise s6 is submission to actual approving body, not adoption. Any independent required approval must bind the final version before adoption.

Shares are provisional, not measured. Native tools first; existing version/draft functions earn zero saving. Save/release each retain one percent using existing checking. Shared material production with 5852 counted once.

tasks.short: Prepare syllabi, homework assignments and course handouts.

actual course timetable and approved policy fields

inputs: actual chosen syllabus/homework/handout content
source-linked actual fixed course-material sections

loop.purpose: Draft variable course instructions and explanations
loop.input: teacher-chosen objectives, examples and verified course sections
loop.check: Verify scientific meaning, solvability, units, required sources, student workload and no omitted instructions
loop.stop: Missing content or two failed checks requires manual material writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Native fixed syllabus sections first; variable scientific explanation alone needs bounded drafting

steps.what: Check complete final course materials, scientific correctness, assignment answers, accessibility and release destination

outputs: actual syllabi/homework/handouts available to intended learners
